Name: Verify failed
Description: The robot typed or clicked and the field did not read back as expected, or the click itself failed.
Recommended Action: Open the run screenshot, check the window and the click-map row, then resubmit.

Name: Step timeout
Description: The run went past its time limit.
Recommended Action: Check whether Irium was slow or stuck; if the work is legitimately long, raise the route timeout, then resubmit.

Name: Coordinate target missing
Description: No active click-map row for the screen element the robot needs.
Recommended Action: Add or activate the row in the click-map data, then resubmit.

Name: Input envelope invalid
Description: The order data sent to the robot is missing something or names a route, module or action the robot does not know.
Recommended Action: Fix the order or the automation setup, then resubmit.

Name: Route URL unresolved
Description: The route has no flow URL, so the item cannot be sent to the robot.
Recommended Action: Set the route's Flow URL to RPA Dispatch, then resubmit.

Name: Test window title format changed
Description: The stored Rental test window title has no "Train M/D" anchor, so the test database date cannot be synced.
Recommended Action: Re-capture the module window titles on the Test system, update the Rental Modules row, then resubmit.

Name: Irium business rejection
Description: Irium refused the change by a business rule.
Recommended Action: Review the reason with the order owner, correct the order, and resubmit if appropriate.

Name: Child flow abandoned
Description: No result from the robot within the stale limit (lrev_StaleTimeoutMinutes_Async).
Recommended Action: Check the desktop flow run and Irium; resubmit only if the work did not happen.

Name: Irium not ready
Recommended Action: Check the VM, Irium install path, and that no stale instance is wedged.

Name: Irium login failed
Recommended Action: Verify the credential and that the login screen layout/coordinates are current.

Name: Unknown window state
Description: No known screen matched within timeout.
Recommended Action: Open the failure screenshot; add the new screen to the state data if it is legitimate.

Name: Dispatch failure
Description: Q-Reactor could not reach RPA Dispatch (HTTP error or timeout). The robot did not start.
Recommended Action: Check the route's Flow URL and that RPA Dispatch is on, then resubmit.

Name: Workspace reset failed
Description: Preparing the worker machine failed: apps left open, display not 1920x1080, or more than one monitor.
Recommended Action: Fix the worker session, then resubmit.

Name: Irium process down
Description: The module process did not come up within 20 seconds of opening it.
Recommended Action: Check that Irium starts on the worker machine (login, license, network), then resubmit the item.

Name: Irium process not responding
Description: The module process is running but Windows reports it as not responding.
Recommended Action: Close the hung Irium window on the worker machine, then resubmit the item.

Name: Unknown error
Description: The robot failed without an error code.
Recommended Action: Read the run log; add a catalog row once the cause is known.

Name: No result from the robot
Description: The desktop flow action failed or timed out (machine offline, PAD stopped, connection broken, run over the time limit), so the robot returned no result.
Recommended Action: Check the machine and the desktop flow run, then check Irium before resubmitting.

Name: RPA Dispatch failed before the robot
Description: RPA Dispatch failed before it called the robot.
Recommended Action: Open the RPA Dispatch run history, fix the cause, then resubmit.
